change.runContract: Each completed evaluation run lists its main_model call UUIDs in modelCallIds; every ID must also appear in its receiptIds. The database verifier requires the exact persisted call-ID set for completed or failed runs.

change.modelRequest: Every persisted main_model call must have a valid input_hash matching its saved input, a user message with the exact frozen question, and a system message containing the frozen knowledgeScope restriction. The verifier reads these fields from tenant-scoped database rows rather than the submitted evaluation file.
